reconstruction.exact_original_bytes: Use git show FIXED_COMMIT:FULL_PATH or git cat-file blob EXACT_BLOB. Every one of the five whole original outputs has an independently computed complete SHA256 and Git identity.
reconstruction.scientific_regeneration: Retained full original commands, sources, helpers, fixed inputs, settings and resource objects define the old derived computations. Run only in an authorized scientific environment; none was executed here.

R96_two_complete_commands.complete_input_files: Six pinned inputs are embedded in the source; execute from the topic directory.
R96_two_complete_commands.note: Terminal execution metadata changes the fresh complete file hash; the full-input recovery adapter checks that exact supplied hash, all six original input hashes, executed v2 source hash and all 26 gates. Fresh outputs remain separately named.
R96_two_complete_commands.storage_rule: No connector transmission of chunks of the complete 207334-byte primary. Preserve full data by terminal git when execution returns.

reconstruction.original_source_paths_and_environment: Original interpreter and workdir strings are retained without pretending that a later interpreter or same-named source has the old identity. Package/version fields not originally recorded remain unknown.
